goal: Is ke baad aap pass by value aur pass by reference ka farq bata sakein ge, aisa swap function likh sakein ge jo waqai swap kare, aur function se ek se zyada results wapas la sakein ge.
warmup: Aap apne dost ko apne notes ki photocopy dete hain. Woh photocopy par jagah jagah likh deta hai, lekin ghar par rakhe aap ke notes saaf rehte hain. Yeh pass by value hai: function ko copy milti hai. Ab socho ke aap apni asal copy hi usay thama dein. Agar woh us mein likhe to aap ki copy badal jati hai. Yeh pass by reference hai: function asal cheez par kaam karta hai.
definition: Jab aap function call karte hain to jo values bhejte hain unhein arguments kehte hain. Pass by value ka matlab hai ke function har argument ki ek COPY receive karta hai, is liye function ke andar parameter badalne se caller ka variable nahi badalta. Pass by reference ka matlab hai ke parameter & ke saath likha jata hai (misaal ke taur par int &a). Yeh naya box nahi banata. Yeh caller ke apne variable ka doosra naam (alias) ban jata hai, is liye function ke andar ki tabdeeliyan caller ke variable ko BADAL deti hain.
howItWorks: Pehli trace ko step by step chalayein aur call stack panel dekhein. swapByValue mein function ke apne boxes a aur b hote hain. Woh x aur y ki copies ke taur par shuru hote hain. Function copies ko swap karta hai, phir copies phenk di jati hain. main mein ab bhi x = 10 aur y = 20 hai, is liye swap nakaam raha. Doosri trace mein header mein int &a, int &b likha hai. Ab a wohi box hai jo x hai aur b wohi box hai jo y hai, is liye swap main ke variables ko badal deta hai aur kaam karta hai. Kab kya use karein? Pass by value tab use karein jab function ko sirf number PARHNA ho (zyada tar functions). Pass by reference tab use karein jab function ko caller ka variable BADALNA ho, ya jab usay ek se zyada results wapas dene hon (function return se sirf ek value wapas kar sakta hai, lekin woh kai reference parameters bhar sakta hai). Do rules yaad rakhein: reference parameter ka argument variable hona chahiye, 5 jaisa constant nahi. Aur array alag hai: jab aap array function ko pass karte hain to function asal array par kaam karta hai, is liye tabdeeliyan barqarar rehti hain. Tafseelat aap agle hafton mein seekhein ge.
